_about: The DPDP Compass rule book. For each checklist obligation, the requirements one section of a privacy policy must meet. Each requirement: rule (shown to users), basis (the provision), fix (advice when it fails), and tests, all of which must hold: match = regex the section must contain; absent = regex it must not contain; scope = 'policy' to test the whole policy instead of the section; check = a named test in rulebook.py (max_90_days, email_or_phone, retention_period). Regexes are case-insensitive. The generator's draft (rulebook.draft) must keep passing every rule: run python -m app.compass.rulebook after any edit.

NOTICE.rule: Lists each item of personal data collected
NOTICE.fix: List each item of personal data you collect, e.g. 'We collect your name, mobile number and email address.'

NOTICE.rule: States the purpose of the processing
NOTICE.fix: Say what each item of data is used for, e.g. 'We use your address to deliver orders.' Avoid 'business purposes'.

NOTICE.rule: Describes the service the data is used for
NOTICE.fix: Describe the goods or services the processing enables, e.g. 'our online grocery delivery service'.

NOTICE.rule: Gives the website or app link for rights and withdrawal
NOTICE.fix: Give the link to your website or app where people withdraw consent, use their rights and learn how to complain.

NOTICE.rule: Tells people they can complain to the Data Protection Board
NOTICE.fix: Add: 'You can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.'

CONSENT.rule: Consent is given by a clear affirmative action
CONSENT.fix: Say how consent is given, e.g. 'by ticking an unticked box' or 'by tapping I agree'.

CONSENT.rule: Asks for consent separately for each purpose
CONSENT.fix: Say you ask for consent separately for each purpose and never bundle it with your terms of service.

CONSENT.rule: Collects only the data needed for the purpose
CONSENT.fix: Add: 'We collect only the personal data that is necessary for the purposes stated.'

CONSENT.rule: Does not treat use of the service as consent
CONSENT.fix: Remove wording like 'by using this service you agree'. Using a service is not consent.

LANGUAGE.rule: Written in clear and plain language
LANGUAGE.fix: Say the notice and consent requests are in clear and plain language.

LANGUAGE.rule: Readable in English or an Eighth Schedule language
LANGUAGE.fix: Say people can read the notice in English or any language in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution, and how to choose one.

WITHDRAWAL.rule: Consent can be withdrawn at any time
WITHDRAWAL.fix: Say: 'You can withdraw your consent at any time.'

WITHDRAWAL.rule: Withdrawing is as easy as giving consent
WITHDRAWAL.fix: Say withdrawing is as easy as giving consent, and make it so in the product.
Give the exact way to withdraw, e.g. 'Settings > Privacy > Withdraw consent' or an email address.
Say you and your processors stop processing within a reasonable time after withdrawal.

PROCESSOR.rule: Processors act only on the company's behalf
PROCESSOR.fix: Say service providers process personal data only on your behalf and under your instructions.

PROCESSOR.rule: Processors are bound by a contract with security safeguards
PROCESSOR.fix: Say each service provider is bound by a written contract that requires security safeguards.

ACCURACY.rule: Commits to keeping data complete, accurate and consistent
ACCURACY.fix: Add: 'We take reasonable steps to keep your personal data complete, accurate and consistent.'

SECURITY.fix: Name the safeguards you use, e.g. encryption at rest and in transit, access controls.

SECURITY.rule: Keeps access logs and monitors them
SECURITY.fix: Say you keep logs of access to personal data, monitor them, and keep them for at least one year.
Say you keep backups so processing can continue if data is lost or compromised.

BREACH.fix: Add a section on what you do after a personal data breach.

BREACH.rule: Tells the Data Protection Board, with a report within 72 hours
BREACH.match: data protection board[^.]{0,200}(?:72|seventy-two)|(?:72|seventy-two)[^.]{0,200}data protection board|data protection board
BREACH.fix: Commit to inform the Data Protection Board without delay and send a detailed report within 72 hours.

BREACH.rule: Tells every affected person without delay
BREACH.fix: Commit to inform each affected person without delay, describing the breach, its likely consequences and what they can do.

ERASURE.rule: Erases data on withdrawal of consent or when the purpose ends
ERASURE.fix: Say you erase personal data when consent is withdrawn or the purpose is served, unless a law requires you to keep it.
Give a period for each kind of data, e.g. 'invoices 8 years (GST law), support chats 12 months'.
Replace 'forever' or 'as long as necessary' with a period people can check.

ERASURE.rule: Keeps processing logs for at least one year
ERASURE.fix: Say you keep personal data, traffic data and logs of processing for at least one year from the processing, then erase them.

CONTACT.rule: Names a Data Protection Officer or privacy contact
CONTACT.match: data protection officer|\bdpo\b(?![@.\w])|privacy officer|grievance officer|contact person|designated person
CONTACT.fix: Name your Data Protection Officer or the person who answers privacy questions.

CONTACT.rule: Gives an email address or phone number
CONTACT.fix: Publish an email address or phone number for privacy questions.

GRIEVANCE.rule: Explains how to raise a grievance
GRIEVANCE.fix: Explain how to raise a grievance about personal data.
Name the Grievance Officer and give their email address.
State a response time of at most 90 days, e.g. 'We will respond within 30 days.'

GRIEVANCE.rule: Says people can then go to the Board
GRIEVANCE.fix: Add: 'If you are not satisfied with our response, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.'

CHILDREN.fix: Say how you treat anyone under 18.

CHILDREN.rule: Requires verifiable consent of a parent or lawful guardian
CHILDREN.fix: Say you process data of anyone under 18 only with the verifiable consent of a parent or lawful guardian, and how you verify it.

CHILDREN.rule: No tracking or targeted ads aimed at children
CHILDREN.fix: Say you do not track or monitor children's behaviour or direct targeted advertising at them.

ACCESS.rule: A summary of the personal data held
ACCESS.fix: Say people can get a summary of their personal data and the processing done on it.

ACCESS.rule: Who the data was shared with
ACCESS.fix: Say people can learn who you shared their data with.
Say people can have their data corrected, completed, updated or erased.
Give the email, form or setting through which people make these requests.
Say which details you need to identify the person, e.g. their registered email or mobile number.

NOMINATION.fix: Say people can nominate one or more individuals to exercise their rights.
Say the nominee acts if the person dies or becomes incapable.
Give the form, setting or email through which people nominate.
